input.free_text_description: This system is a search platform that serves Admin, Developer roles. The platform provides capabilities for request handler, subcatalog properties, staccato error web exception handler. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a Admin, I want to interact with api functionality, so that I can accomplish my api-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with collection functionality, so that I can accomplish my collection-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with staccato advice functionality, so that I can accomplish my staccato advice-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with oaf functionality, so that I can accomplish my oaf-related tasks.
